status: Design only. Not a solution file; nothing here can be imported. Do not deploy.

conventions.names: Logical names below are unprefixed; the renderer applies '<prefix>_'. All lowercase.
conventions.choices: Option values are ordinals here; on creation they become optionValuePrefix * 10000 + ordinal.
conventions.ownership: Organisation-owned unless stated, so the read-only role can be granted at organisation level.

tables.name: signal
tables.description: One row per external change: Message Center post, incident, roadmap item, blog post or manual entry.

columns.name: externalid
columns.description: MC…, RM… or MO… id

columns.name: summarytext
columns.description: Readable plain text of summary, made by the Readable summary flow (engine ConvertTo-ReadableText); summary keeps the text as collected

columns.name: products
columns.description: Comma-separated, as published; facets live in signalfingerprint

columns.name: confidencelabel
columns.description: e.g. 'community archive' for lower-confidence sources (§3.1)

columns.name: fingerprintedon
columns.description: When the fingerprint flow last fingerprinted this signal; refingerprinted when lastchanged is later (ADR 0009)

columns.name: genericimpact
columns.description: LLM generic rating for a typical enterprise, set once per signal (ADR 0012)

columns.name: nature
columns.description: Type of change (LLM, ADR 0012)

columns.name: impacttype
columns.description: Risk, opportunity, or both (LLM opportunity lens, spec §6, ADR 0012)

columns.name: risk
columns.description: One-sentence risk for a typical enterprise (LLM)

columns.name: opportunity
columns.description: One-sentence opportunity: advisory, governance, adoption, content (LLM)

columns.name: audience
columns.description: Who needs to know, semicolon-separated (LLM)

columns.name: theme
columns.description: One theme from seed/themes.csv (LLM, checked against the list)

columns.name: ratingconfidence
columns.description: high, medium or low (LLM)

columns.name: ratedon
columns.description: When the signal-level rating was set; it is set again only when the signal changes (ADR 0012)

columns.name: feed
columns.description: The feed that collected this signal when source is feed (ADR 0014)

columns.name: watched
columns.description: On the watch list: changes to it raise watch.updated. Set by a matching watch, or by hand (ADR 0015)

columns.name: watch
columns.description: The watch topic that put it on the watch list; empty when watched by hand (ADR 0015)

columns.name: watchedon
columns.description: When a watch topic put it on the watch list (ADR 0015)

tables.name: signalversion
tables.description: History of a signal, for change tracking and signal.changed events.

tables.name: signalfingerprint
tables.description: What a signal touches, in the shared vocabulary. 'group' holds alternatives (OR); facets within a group are ANDed.

columns.name: reason
columns.description: Why the LLM chose this facet (quoted or paraphrased from the signal), shown in the review queue (ADR 0009)

columns.name: status
columns.description: Review queue (spec gap G11)

tables.name: asset
tables.description: One row per estate resource. Keyed on stable source ids so E1 needs no rework.

columns.name: resourcetype
columns.description: Inventory type, e.g. microsoft.powerapps/canvasapps

columns.name: microsoftsystem
columns.description: Shipped by a Microsoft publisher (e.g. a system prompt): its exposures are shown with status system and never rated or alerted (Simon, 2026-11-22)

columns.name: ownerobjectid
columns.description: Entra object id; not a lookup, owners aren't Dataverse users

columns.name: sourceid
columns.description: environment id + resource id + solution unique name

columns.name: source
columns.description: Indexed: drives the 'Demo data' badge

columns.name: syntheticorg
columns.description: Required when source is not live

columns.name: criticality
columns.description: Populated by E1 later; ignored in v1

columns.name: componentid
columns.description: Dataverse component id from inventory: appModuleId (model-driven app), workflowEntityId (flow), name (canvas app). Joins Dataverse detail to the asset (ADR 0008)

tables.name: assetfingerprint
tables.description: What an asset uses, in the shared vocabulary, with the source field as evidence.

tables.name: tenantsetting
tables.description: Tenant-level settings for setting checks (spending policies, subprocessors). Manual at first.

columns.name: scope
columns.description: Products the setting covers

tables.name: rule
tables.description: Deterministic facet joins. Seeded from seed/rules.csv.

columns.name: rulecode
columns.description: Stable rule identifier, e.g. R-PRODUCT (rule_id in seed/rules.csv)

tables.name: facetvalue
tables.description: The shared vocabulary. Seeded from seed/vocabulary.csv; installers can add values.

columns.name: name
columns.description: facet: value, e.g. 'connector: shared_sharepointonline'. Primary name, so not used in the key (primary name columns are stored at 850 characters)

columns.name: aliases
columns.description: Other spellings of the value, separated by '|' (model facet, ADR 0013): matched ignoring case

tables.name: exposure
tables.description: Signal × asset (or tenant setting) match, with evidence.

columns.name: asset
columns.description: Empty for setting exposures

columns.name: rules
columns.description: Rule ids that matched; multi-rule matches are normal

columns.name: source
columns.description: Copied from asset so ratings never mix live and synthetic

tables.name: assessment
tables.description: Estate-specific rating per signal, with an override.

columns.name: rationale
columns.description: LLM-written; labelled as assessment, not fact

columns.name: overrideimpact
columns.description: Impact set by a reviewer, overriding the estate impact

columns.name: unknownenvcount
columns.description: Exposed assets whose environment type is unknown: no production bonus for them (ADR 0010)

columns.name: productionbonus
columns.description: +1 applied: an exposed asset is in a production environment

columns.name: actionbonus
columns.description: +1 applied: action required and the key date is within 30 days or past

columns.name: exposuresummary
columns.description: The names-free estate summary sent to the assessment prompt; the prompt runs again only when it or the signal changes

columns.name: overriddenon
columns.description: When the override was last set or changed

tables.name: event
tables.description: Raised by each pipeline step; the dispatcher triggers on new rows.

columns.name: handler
columns.description: Child flow name

columns.name: writes
columns.description: Handlers that write outside Change Radar ship disabled

tables.name: handlerrun
tables.description: Idempotency log: what each handler did for each event.

tables.name: collectionrun
tables.description: One row per collector run, recording the detected access tier so the dashboard can show it.

columns.name: gaps
columns.description: What this tier couldn't see

tables.name: feed
tables.description: A configurable signal source read by the generic Collect feeds flow. Seeded from seed/feeds.csv and seed/feed-profiles/ (ADR 0014).

columns.name: key
columns.description: Prefix for external ids, e.g. ML-PR

columns.name: profile
columns.description: JSON: table profiles, sections and keywords, or RSS label

columns.name: lastmarker
columns.description: Page git_commit_id or newest item date; an unchanged source is skipped

columns.name: unrated
columns.description: Signals from this feed are never fingerprinted or rated by the LLM; they feed the watch list and Ask Change Radar only (ADR 0018, ADR 0019)

tables.name: watch
tables.description: A watch list topic: new or changed signals whose title or summary match it go on the watch list and raise watch.matched; changes to watched signals raise watch.updated (ADR 0015).

columns.name: anyof
columns.description: Semicolon-separated words or phrases; one must appear (whole words, any case)

columns.name: alsooneof
columns.description: Optional: semicolon-separated; one of these must appear too

columns.name: ignorephrases
columns.description: Optional: semicolon-separated phrases removed before checking, e.g. Windows Autopilot

columns.name: products
columns.description: Optional: semicolon-separated; one must be in the signal's products

tables.name: solution
tables.description: A Dataverse solution that holds estate assets, per environment (ADR 0020). Default, Active and the Common Data Services Default Solution are never stored. Written by the detail flow (live) and the estate import (synthetic).

columns.name: name
columns.description: Display name

columns.name: publisher
columns.description: Publisher unique name

columns.name: microsoft
columns.description: Published by a Microsoft publisher (seed/asset-signatures.json pcfMicrosoftPublishers): grouped as Microsoft solutions

columns.name: source
columns.description: live or synthetic, as the assets it holds

tables.name: solutionmember
tables.description: An asset's membership of a solution (ADR 0020). One asset can be in several solutions. Rows that no longer hold are deleted by the detail flow.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Asset name in solution name

columns.name: solution
columns.description: Referential: a table can have only one parental relationship (asset). The detail flow deletes a solution's member rows before the solution
